goal: Make compare(a, b) and sort(versions) in src/semver.js correct, export both with CommonJS, and add comprehensive tests in test/semver.test.js.

steps.title: Parse versions and reject invalid input
steps.detail: Validate version strings in src/semver.js. Invalid versions passed to compare throw a TypeError whose message starts with 'Invalid version'. Invalid: '1.2', 'v1.2.3', '1.2.3.4', '01.2.3', empty string. Add or update focused tests in test/semver.test.js for invalid input.

steps.title: Compare numeric version components
steps.detail: Implement numeric comparison of major, minor, and patch in compare(a, b). Major, minor, patch compare as numbers (1.2.10 is greater than 1.2.9). Examples: compare('1.2.10','1.2.9') is 1; compare('1.0.0','1.0.0') is 0. Add or update focused tests in test/semver.test.js for numeric precedence.

steps.title: Compare prerelease identifiers
steps.detail: Implement prerelease precedence in compare(a, b). A version with a prerelease is lower than the same version without; prerelease identifiers (dot separated) compare left to right: two numeric identifiers compare as numbers, two non-numeric identifiers compare as text in ASCII order, a numeric identifier is lower than a non-numeric one, and when all shared identifiers are equal the version with fewer identifiers is lower. Examples in ascending order: 1.0.0-alpha, 1.0.0-alpha.1, 1.0.0-alpha.beta, 1.0.0-beta, 1.0.0-beta.2, 1.0.0-beta.11, 1.0.0-rc.1, 1.0.0. Add or update focused tests in test/semver.test.js for prerelease precedence.

steps.title: Ignore build metadata when comparing
steps.detail: Implement build-metadata comparison in compare(a, b). Build metadata is ignored (2.0.0+build.1 and 2.0.0+build.2 compare equal). Example: compare('2.0.0+build.1','2.0.0+build.2') is 0. Add or update focused tests in test/semver.test.js for build metadata.

steps.title: Sort versions without changing input
steps.detail: Implement sort(versions) so that it returns a NEW array in ascending order without changing the input. Invalid versions make sort throw a TypeError whose message starts with 'Invalid version'. Example: sort(['1.10.0','1.2.0','1.2.0-rc.1']) is ['1.2.0-rc.1','1.2.0','1.10.0']. Add or update focused tests in test/semver.test.js for sorting, invalid input, and input immutability.

steps.title: Run the whole test suite
steps.detail: Run npm test. Change nothing unless it fails; fix only failures that this plan's change caused.
